title: Kya Kool Hain Hum 3
desc: A porn actor uses his fellow adult movie stars in creating a fake traditional family, in order to impress his girlfriend's conservative father.

title: Badal
desc: Badal witnesses his family being massacred during a riot in his village. He is raised by a terrorist and soon sets out to exact revenge on the police officer responsible for his family's murder.

title: Parwana
desc: Parwana spends his days brightening the lives of the downtrodden with a series of odd jobs. Just as Parwana falls in love and marries the girl of his dreams, a group of vicious criminals label him a traitor and Parwana is thrown behind bars. Despite the mafia's best attempts to permanently silent Parwana as he languishes in jail, the daring hero escapes and sets out on a mission to clear his name and expose the real criminals.

title: Dharam Chakara (dharam Chakaram Tamil 1997)
desc: A village leader who loses a fight to his enemy Arumugam, causing the death of his lover Vijayalakshmi. Years later, another woman named Vijayalakshmi enters the village, and Chakkaravarthy defends her from Arumugam's goons, rekindling his fight for justice.
